what: Search hook changed from blocking to always-soft. Agent may already have matching memories from path-based aide_recall, so blocking forces redundant aide_search calls. Soft nudge lets agent decide whether to call aide_search based on what's already in context. Validated: agent correctly skipped aide_search when memories were already recalled.
why: Validation showed agent being forced to make redundant aide_search calls for memories it already had from aide_recall. Soft approach respects agent judgment.
